nuggets.text: UTEP's campus is built in Bhutanese style, inspired by photos in a 1914 issue of National Geographic.
The Miners nickname may trace to a state bill whose author mistakenly wrote 'Miners' instead of 'Mines.'
The first play in Sun Bowl Stadium history, in 1963, was a 54-yard touchdown run by the Miners' Larry Durham.
Paydirt Pete, a prospector caricature, became the Miners' mascot after a 1974 student vote.
Scotty Walden was 26 when East Texas Baptist made him the nation's youngest college head football coach.
The Miners are the first Mountain West school to wear two jersey patches.
Brothers Cash and Carver Cheeks, both Northern Colorado transfers, now play together for the Miners.
Jon Teicher is calling his 46th season of Miners football on the radio.
Isaiah Bogerty, a 2025 All-SWAC second-team linebacker at Texas Southern, now plays for the Miners.
This is the Miners' first season in the Mountain West after two decades in Conference USA.
